2707000.name: Hovernyan Ace
2707000.description:
Me, the "Ace"? All right,
which Ace do you want?
The gutsy Ace of Spades?
The gritty Ace of Diamonds?
It's gotta be Hearts, right!?
2707000.befriend1:
That power of yours...
magnificent!▽
Become my rival...!!
2707000.befriend2:
Thank you...!▽
I swear I'll lend you
my strength...!!
2707000.befriend3:
That power of yours...
magnificent!▽
Become my rival...!!
2707000.befriend4:
That power of yours...
magnificent!▽
Become my rival...!!
2707000.skill_description: Elegant sword thrusts pop Wib Wobs

2236900.name: Hovernyan S
2236900.description:
Friendship, grit and effort!
After brutal training,
Hovernyan finally hit S rank.
His guts and fire are a bit
much, but his power is real.
2236900.befriend1:
I saw it...
your guts...!!▽
We could make a fine
friendship, you and me...!
2236900.befriend2:
You got me out
of the Crank-a-kai...!!▽
Take all this
overflowing guts!!
2236900.befriend3:
GUUUUUUUUUTS!!!▽
Sorry...
I got a bit fired up...!
2236900.befriend4:
GUUUUUUUUUTS!!!▽
Sorry...
I got a bit fired up...!
2236900.skill_description: A straight punch pops central Wib Wobs

9000301.name: Kyubi (Shadow)
9000301.description:
A legendary Yo-kai whose
nine tails hold vast power.
Graceful yet savage, it is
feared and revered, above all
by fox Yo-kai.
9000301.befriend1:
Grrrrr...
Will you be my kin
and fight at my side?
9000301.befriend2:
Grrrrr...
Will you be my kin
and fight at my side?
9000301.befriend3:
Grrrrr...
Will you be my kin
and fight at my side?
9000301.befriend4:
Grrrrr...
Will you be my kin
and fight at my side?

9000302.name: Kyubi (Light)
9000302.description:
A legendary Yo-kai with
nine tails, as the name says.
Long years among humans
have given it a calm,
composed air that suits it.
9000302.befriend1:
Hm, you have good eyes.
I shall lend you my power.
9000302.befriend2:
Hm, you have good eyes.
I shall lend you my power.
9000302.befriend3:
Hm, you have good eyes.
I shall lend you my power.
9000302.befriend4:
Hm, you have good eyes.
I shall lend you my power.
9000302.skill_description: Pops Wib Wobs, heals more if it pops itself

2939000.name: Wobblehover
2939000.description:
A kitty Yo-kai who inspirits
the phones of tired adults
on their commute. The joy of
poking and popping Wib Wobs
recharges their spirits.
2939000.befriend1:
Nice to meet ya~.
Been popping lately?
2939000.befriend2:
Nice to meet ya~.
Been popping lately?
2939000.befriend3:
Nice to meet ya~.
Been popping lately?
2939000.befriend4:
Nice to meet ya~.
Been popping lately?
2939000.skill_description: Throws a giant Wib Wob to make Big Wobs

2116000.name: Benkei
2116000.description:
He hides 999 swords taken
from foes he defeated
inside his belly.
When the time comes, they
fly out and skewer enemies.
2116000.befriend1:
I can't believe I lost...
Then there's only one way.▽
We must become
friends!
2116000.befriend2:
Twice in one life I meet
my destiny...▽
I shall follow you
wherever you go...!!
2116000.befriend3:
So you're my new master!
Our fates are now one!
2116000.befriend4:
So you're my new master!
Our fates are now one!
2116000.skill_description: Unleashes his hidden swords to slash Wib Wobs

2714000.name: Daikoku
2714000.description:
A Lucky God Yo-kai of good
harvests and fortune. Land
that gets a tap from his
little mallet comes alive,
promising a bumper crop.
2714000.befriend1:
Mooo~ you're way too strong~.▽
How'd you get
like that~?
2714000.befriend2:
Aren't you hungry?▽
Mooo~
I'll whip up anything~.
2714000.befriend3:
You picked me~.
Mooo~ I'm so happy~.
2714000.befriend4:
You picked me~.
Mooo~ I'm so happy~.
2714000.skill_description: Big damage to 1 enemy (huge if lucky)

2683000.name: Mecha Kyubi
2683000.description:
Probing Kyubi's power was
forbidden, until science
from the future broke it.
Its nine tails are shaped
from dangerous energy.
2683000.befriend1:
I DO NOT KNOW
WHAT I LACK...▽
WILL YOU
TEACH ME...?
2683000.befriend2:
I AM MECHA KYUBI...▽
COOLER THAN
THE ORIGINAL...
2683000.befriend3:
YOU HAVE
GOOD TASTE.▽
I WILL PROTECT YOU,
COOLLY.
2683000.befriend4:
YOU HAVE
GOOD TASTE.▽
I WILL PROTECT YOU,
COOLLY.

2649000.name: Ashura
2649000.description:
A lone god of war who
fights an endless battle
with a rage that never
cools. Wherever his six
arms go, hellfire follows.
2649000.befriend1:
I don't mind strong guys.▽
With you around I could
get even stronger.
2649000.befriend2:
I have to
keep fighting.▽
Will you come along?
2649000.befriend3:
What, you want
to fight me?▽
Come on... I'll take you on.
2649000.befriend4:
What, you want
to fight me?▽
Come on... I'll take you on.
2649000.skill_description: Four arms pop Wib Wobs in several areas

2112000.name: General Genma
2112000.description:
A warlord's spirit, revived
when his long-lost helmet
and armor came together.
He still seeks to unite
the land, as he once failed.
2112000.befriend1:
Not bad, you.
Be my retainer...▽
No! Be my
friend instead!?
2112000.befriend2:
What, you're not here
to be my retainer...?▽
Well, fine!
Let's be off!
2112000.befriend3:
So you're my new retainer!
Carry on!
2112000.befriend4:
So you're my new retainer!
Carry on!
2112000.skill_description: Draws his sword to make bonus orbs
